fields.name: arrival_date
fields.description: Mandatory arrival date only. Default format is %Y-%m-%d; a value carrying a time or timezone does not cast to a date, and a blank cell is a missing-value violation rather than a different type.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Free text note. Blank cells and the literal token N/A are both accepted as missing (null).

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Full numeric value. It still casts as a number above the bound, but any value greater than 1000 violates the maximum constraint.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: Reserved text column. The actual batch happens to be entirely blank here; blank cells stay missing and must not be reported as a type change.

fields.name: tail_note
fields.description: Text column whose leading fragment is blank and whose actual values only arrive in later rows. A blank head must not be interpreted as a type change.
